Metadata.title: Document Q&A
Metadata.description: Citable answers from Persian and English documents

Home.eyebrow: Evidence first, from upload to answer
Home.title: Ask your documents. Check every answer.
Home.description: Add a Persian or English PDF or text file, ask naturally, and inspect the exact page and passage behind the answer.

Auth.loginDescription: Sign in with the email and password you used to create your account.
Auth.registerDescription: Choose a display name, enter your email, and use a strong password with at least 12 characters.
Auth.resetDescription: An administrator gives you a short-lived reset token after verifying your recovery request. No external email service is used.
Auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
Auth.resetCompleted: Password updated. You can now sign in.
Auth.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
Auth.registrationUnavailable: This account cannot be created. Try signing in or use password recovery.
Auth.passwordTooShort: Use at least 12 characters for your password.
Auth.invalidReset: This reset token is invalid, expired, or already used.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
Auth.serviceUnavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
Auth.genericError: This action could not be completed safely. Try again.

Workspace.startDescription: A collection keeps related documents and conversations together. Give this one a clear name; you can upload the first source next.
Workspace.collectionDescriptionPlaceholder: What kind of documents belong here?
Workspace.fileRequirements: PDF or UTF-8 TXT · up to 50 MB
Workspace.noDocumentsDescription: Upload one source to prepare evidence for your questions.
Workspace.readySources: {count, plural, one {# source ready} other {# sources ready}}
Workspace.chatEmptyTitle: Your answer will stay close to the evidence
Workspace.chatEmptyReady: Ask a specific question. The answer will include the supporting document and page.
Workspace.chatEmptyWaiting: Upload a document and wait until processing is complete before asking a question.
Workspace.answerFailed: The answer could not be completed safely.
Workspace.feedbackReason_unsupported: The evidence does not support it
Workspace.feedbackReason_should_have_abstained: It should have said there was not enough evidence
Workspace.feedbackError: Feedback could not be saved. Try again.
Workspace.deleteDocumentConfirmation: Delete “{name}”? It will immediately stop being used for answers.
Workspace.deleteCollectionConfirmation: Delete “{name}” and all of its documents? They will immediately stop being used for answers.
Workspace.questionPlaceholder: Ask a question about the ready documents…
Workspace.questionDisabled: Wait until at least one document is ready…
Workspace.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
Workspace.evidenceNote: This passage is preserved from the processed source. Retrieval normalization never replaces the displayed source text.
Workspace.errorFileTooLarge: This file is larger than 50 MB. Choose a smaller PDF or text file.
Workspace.errorEmptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a file that contains text.
Workspace.errorUnsupportedType: Only text-based PDF and UTF-8 TXT files are supported in this release.
Workspace.errorFileMismatch: The file content does not match its name or reported type.
Workspace.errorTextEncoding: This text file is not valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 and try again.
Workspace.errorEncryptedPdf: This PDF is password protected. Remove encryption before uploading it.
Workspace.errorScannedPdf: This PDF appears to contain scanned images. OCR is not available in this release.
Workspace.errorPdfExtraction: Text could not be read reliably from this PDF. Try exporting a text-based PDF.
Workspace.errorProcessingUnavailable: Document processing is temporarily unavailable. Your file is safe; retry shortly.
Workspace.errorNetwork: The service could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
Workspace.errorInvalidCitations: The generated citation could not be verified, so the answer was not saved as grounded.
Workspace.errorAnswerFailed: The answer pipeline failed safely. You can retry the question.
Workspace.errorDocumentQuotaExceeded: You have reached the document limit for this beta. Delete an unused document or contact the administrator.
Workspace.errorQuestionRateLimited: You have asked too many questions in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
Workspace.errorGenerationBusy: Another answer is already being prepared for this account. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
Workspace.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Try the action again.
